items.html: And afterwards, the GAR came at one time, each one included of the ten Sefirot of BaN and the ten Sefirot of MaH; and then ZA is called great and complete, a son of thirteen years. And afterwards, the Keter of MaH and of BaN entered in all the ten Sefirot that are in the Keter, in one day; and behold, he is a son of thirteen years and one day.
